column1: # Performance budget: the commands scripts/perf-gate.mjs times (npm run perf:gate).
#   name <TAB> ceiling_ms <TAB> command <TAB> stdin (optional, one line)
# - command runs from the tree root with no shell: words split on spaces.
# - ceiling_ms is the limit for the fastest run. A breach fails the gate,
#   unless the base is over the ceiling too in the same run (a slow machine
#   then, not the PR; the verdict is over-ceiling-at-base). It is
#   about 2x the value on the owner's Mac (2026-11-09) and stops slow drift
#   across many PRs. Raise it only with a reason in the PR.
# - Every command must be side-effect free and offline. It runs with a small
#   fixed environment (AGENTBREW_EVENTS=0, DO_NOT_TRACK=1) and a scratch HOME.
# - The hook rows get one PreToolUse payload for a plain `git status` Bash
#   call: the path every agent Bash call takes.
# A new hot-path command joins this file in the PR that adds it.
# Runtime paths: the gate times the commands only when the diff touches one.
# Build: the CLI rows run dist/cli.js, so each tree needs a build.
# - PERF_GATE_BUILD runs in a tree root. The base checkout is built once and
#   cached by commit. This tree is rebuilt when PERF_GATE_BUILD_OUTPUT is older
#   than a file under a PERF_GATE_BUILD_INPUT path.
# - PERF_GATE_BUILD_DEPS runs first in the base checkout only, with this tree's
#   root as its last argument (it clones node_modules from there).
# Allow section: one line per intended slowdown above 10% in this PR.
# The ceiling still applies. The next PR removes the line: the gate stops on
# an allow line that the base has unchanged (same name and same reason).
# A PR that changes scripts/perf-gate.mjs needs PERF_GATE_ALLOW=perf-gate:<reason>.
